name: subscription-autopsy
description: Subscription spend analyzer for small businesses — detect recurring charges, flag waste, calculate savings

scripts.test: node -e "const {analyze}=require('./services/analyzer'); const r=analyze('Date,Desc,Amount\n2026-04-01,Netflix,-15.99\n2026-03-01,Netflix,-15.99'); console.log('Subscriptions found:', r.summary.totalSubscriptions); process.exit(r.summary.totalSubscriptions > 0 ? 0 : 1);"
